description: This Scala source file defines a Spark listener class 'ConnectProgressExecutionListener' that tracks job and stage execution progress for Spark connect API, including nested classes for tracking individual stages and managing job tags.

classes.name: ConnectProgressExecutionListener
classes.description: A SparkListener subclass that tracks execution progress of jobs and stages based on tags, managing internal state and reporting progress.

classes.name: ConnectProgressExecutionListener.ExecutionTracker
classes.description: Tracks progress for a specific tag, including jobs and stages, and manages concurrency and state updates.

classes.name: ConnectProgressExecutionListener.StageInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a Spark stage, including task counts, input bytes, and completion status, with thread-safe update methods.

methods.name: yieldWhenDirty
methods.description: Returns current progress state if dirty, optionally forcing report, and resets dirty flag.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a job to the tracker and updates stage info.

methods.name: jobCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tracked jobs.

methods.name: stageCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tracked stages.

methods.name: tryGetTracker
methods.description: Retrieves the tracker for a given tag if it exists.

methods.name: registerJobTag
methods.description: Creates and registers a new tracker for a given tag.

methods.name: removeJobTag
methods.description: Removes the tracker associated with a given tag.

methods.name: clearJobTags
methods.description: Clears all tracked tags and their trackers.
